title: MA61010: Computer Networks
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: void
Introduction, layered network architecture, circuit switching, packet
switching, data link protocols, stop and wait, sliding window, HDLC, queuing
systems and other Markov systems – delay analysis in data network, LAN
protocols, CSMA/CD, token ring, FDDI, network layer routing, repeaters,
bridges, gateways, TCP/IP, internet protocols.
